description: DLSS 5 MANAGER is a one-click manager and mod installer for DLSS 5, ReShade, OptiScaler and Live Flow.
notes: Non-portable installer: installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DLSS 5 MANAGER (~1.1 GB, includes the mod payloads) and creates Start Menu and Desktop shortcuts.

script: $dlssApp = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\DLSS 5 MANAGER'; $dlssExe = Join-Path $dlssApp 'DLSS 5 MANAGER.exe'; $dlssDeadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(15); do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $dlssBusy = [bool](Get-Process -Name 'DLSS.5.MANAGER.*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) } while ((Get-Date) -lt $dlssDeadline -and ($dlssBusy -or -not (Test-Path $dlssExe))); if (-not (Test-Path $dlssExe)) { throw 'DLSS 5 MANAGER installer did not complete' }
